implementation: Auth content now follows AuthenticationLanding.vue/authentication.css: eyebrow, Voice Platform heading and web intro copy; card max-width 440 px and 24 px page inset; card padding scales from 24 to 40 px; field labels sit above web-sized inputs; the submit control is full width.
